text: Annual family income must not exceed 800,000 rupees.

text: The applicant must be enrolled in an undergraduate degree programme.

text: Both the income certificate and the latest marksheet must be submitted.

text: Score by latest percentage: 90 or above earns 100, 80 to 89 earns 85, 70 to 79 earns 70, 60 to 69 earns 50.
keywords: academic performance percentage marks grades examination result

text: Verified achievements earn points: national level 50, state level 30, institute level 15. The score is the total, capped at 100.
keywords: achievements awards competitions hackathon national state institute level

text: The statement is scored out of 100: clear goals 30, specific evidence with numbers 30, length of 50 to 250 words 20, community impact 20.
keywords: personal statement essay goals motivation writing quality community

text: Score by annual family income: up to 200,000 earns 100, up to 400,000 earns 80, up to 600,000 earns 55, up to 800,000 earns 30.
keywords: family income need annual earnings financial

text: Score by number of dependents in the family: 5 or more earns 100, 3 or 4 earns 70, 1 or 2 earns 40, none earns 10.
keywords: dependents family members household size dependants

text: Score by share of fees already covered by other aid: none earns 100, up to 49 percent earns 60, 50 percent or more earns 20.
keywords: existing financial aid fees covered other scholarship support

text: The final score is 55 percent merit plus 45 percent need.
keywords: final score weights merit need percent weighting

text: A final score of 75 or above is an award, 60 to 74.99 is waitlist, below 60 is reject.
